hero.title: Give your child an outstanding Quranic education
hero.title_html: Give your child an outstanding Quranic education
hero.subtitle: Looking for a modern daara that combines Quran memorization, discipline and personal growth? Al Amine Academy guides your child toward both spiritual and academic success.

home.problems_subtitle: You are not alone. Hundreds of parents share the same concerns.
home.problem_external_text: Finding a reliable daara that delivers real results in Quran memorization while maintaining solid academic standards.
home.problem_internal_text: The fear that your child might lose their values, fall behind academically, or fail to thrive in a controlled environment.
home.problem_philosophical_text: Every child deserves an education that nurtures both mind AND soul, that strengthens faith without compromising the academic future.
home.guide_text: Since 2023, Al Amine Academy has supported families in Senegal in this delicate quest: providing an excellent Islamic education while ensuring each child's well-being and academic success.
home.plan_subtitle: A transparent and easy process to enroll your child.
home.plan_step1_text: Fill out our online registration form. It only takes a few minutes.
home.plan_step2_text: Your child is placed in the program that matches their age and goals.
home.plan_step3_text: Personalized follow-up with regular reports. You see your child's progress in real time.
home.programs_subtitle: Each program is designed to meet your child's specific needs.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Discover the transformations and successes of our students through their families' testimonials.
home.failure_text: Every year of waiting is a year your child does not build the foundation of a structured Islamic education.
home.final_cta_text: Ready to give your child an outstanding Islamic education? Registrations are open for all our programs.
